meals.name: Chicken rice and broccoli
meals.instructions:
Cook the dry rice according to its packet. Cut the broccoli into florets.

Coat the chicken with oil and spices. Pan-cook over medium heat, turning, until its centre reaches 74°C.

Steam the broccoli until tender-crisp. Rest and slice the chicken, then serve with rice.

Boil the eggs until firm. Cut potatoes into even pieces and simmer separately until tender, then drain.

Cool briefly, peel eggs and chop. Mix yogurt, lemon, oil and parsley.

Fold potatoes, eggs and cucumber into the dressing. Serve or chill promptly.

قلب البطاطس والبيض والخيار مع الصلصة وقدمها أو بردها سريعاً.

Nestle the cod into the sauce, cover and cook gently until the centre reaches 63°C.

Wilt the spinach into the sauce and serve with rice.
meals.instructions_ar:
اطه الأرز ولين البصل والثوم بالزيت ثم أضف الطماطم واطه ٥ دقائق.

ضع القد في الصلصة وغطه واطهه بهدوء حتى تبلغ حرارته الداخلية ٦٣°م.

أضف السبانخ حتى تذبل وقدم مع الأرز.
